newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-VELEZ BEAT RIVER PLATE ON PENALITIES TO WIN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VELEZ BEAT RIVER PLATE ON PENALITIES TO WIN CUP.

text.p: South American Super Cup winners Velez Sarsfield beat Libertadores Cup champions River Plate on penalties in the Recopa Cup final on Sunday.
Velez took the match with a 4-2 penalty shootout win after the two teams were level at 1-1 after 90 minutes.
Paraguayan goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, who has won fame for his ability to score goals, converted a spot kick to give Velez a 29th-minute lead.
River Plate equalised with eight minutes remaining when veteran Uruguayan forward Enzo Francescoli converted a penalty to send the match into a penalty shootout.
It was Velez Sarsfield's first title in the Recopa Cup which annually pits the winners of two of South America's most prestigious competitions against each other.
